intro: Many verbs are learned in pairs: читать / прочитать. The imperfective presents the process or repetition; the perfect, a delimited action.

bloques.titulo: Many verbs are learned in pairs: читать / прочитать. The imperfective presents the process or repetition; the perfect, a delimited action.
texto: Many verbs are learned in pairs: читать / прочитать. The imperfective presents the process or repetition; the perfect, a delimited action.
The prefix can change the lexical meaning, so it is appropriate to learn frequent pairs in context and not to add any prefix.

frases.en: I want to read this whole article.

frases.es: Le gusta leer antes de dormir.
frases.en: He likes to read before he sleeps.

bloques.pregunta: What verb does the reading present as completed?

opciones.explicacion: Прочитать presents reading as a delimited or finished action.
This form does not express the relationship that the question calls for.
